item.title: Nivlet 2.0.5 · Build 65
item.description: # Nivlet 2.0.5 · Build 65 macOS 13.0+ · Apple Silicon (arm64) only · Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. ## 简体中文 - 新的应用图标：保留折带 N 的造型，改用石墨灰底板配柔和的青蓝色 N，更贴近 macOS 风格，在深浅色背景下都清晰。 - 菜单栏 N 图标随之重绘，与新图标的折带造型一致。 - 设置窗口和“关于”页使用新图标。 本版本不新增功能，不改变设置项、配置格式或权限。 ## English - New app icon: the folded-ribbon N in soft teal and blue on a graphite plate, closer to macOS style and clear on light and dark backgrounds. - The menu bar N is redrawn to match the new ribbon shape. - The settings window and About page use the new icon. This release adds no features and does not change settings, configuration format or permissions. ## Downloads / 下载 Choose either the DMG or ZIP. Both contain the same signed, stapled Build 65 app. Use the `.sha256` attachment to verify downloads. Version 1.0.8 / Build 55 remains the final Intel release; historical assets are retained. ## Verification / 验证 All command-line regression files, the privacy scan and the runtime patch check passed locally. A locally signed copy of the build launched without errors and showed the new menu bar icon. The final app and DMG passed notarization, stapling and Gatekeeper checks; all embedded Mach-O files are arm64. Only icons and media change in this release. Other Mac/macOS combinations and a live Sparkle installation of Build 65 have not been claimed as tested.
